blurb: Discover unparalleled sophistication and historic charm at The Steam Plant, a historic wedding and event venue in downtown Dayton. This urban sanctuary is steeped in history and modern allure. Originally built in the early 1900’s as a power-generating plant, this staple in downtown Dayton blends modern amenities with industrial chic.
